summary.text: Tara Durant is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 27, serving since 2024.
The district covers all of Fredericksburg City and parts of Spotsylvania and Stafford counties.
Tara Durant served in the House from 2022 to 2024, and the Senate biography lists Tara Durant's occupation as educator.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Tara Durant was born in Des Moines, Iowa.
It lists a B.A. in Political Science and Communication from Coe College.
Tara Durant serves on the Education and Health, Local Government, and Privileges and Elections committees.
